# News {.unnumbered}

Versions of this website, newest first. Every version remains available through the version menu in the sidebar, and every change to the text and code is recorded in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/MaartenMarsman/computational-methods-book).

## Development version {.unnumbered}

Not yet released. Online in the development version:

- the welcome page;
- Chapter 1, Probability and Simulation;
- Chapter 2, Bayesian Inference, Revisited;
- Chapter 3, Markov Chains;
- Chapter 4, Diagnosing Markov Chains;
- Chapter 5, The Metropolis Algorithm;
- Appendices A–D: software setup, notation, technical notes on MCMC (including the acceptance-probability derivation), and conjugate-posterior derivations.

The appendices now include updated setup instructions and package lists, revised notation, and a step-by-step derivation of the variance of a dependent average.
